name: com.simutrends/simutrends
title: Simutrends
description: Test a business idea on a simulated market of AI personas. Pay per study with x402 (USDC on Base).

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Lists the available study templates, what each one is for and its defaults. Free.

tools.name: estimate_study
tools.description: Returns the exact price, estimated time and sample plan for a study, without running it or charging anything. Free. Use it before start_study so the user can confirm the price.

idea.description: The product, idea or topic to study, in plain words. For a product include the price and how it works. Do not embellish it: agents react to exactly this text.

template.description: saas_validation: reaction to a product. route_comparison: choose between 2 or 3 routes (requires options). problem_discovery: what hurts in an industry, without showing a solution.

options.description: Only for route_comparison: the 2 or 3 routes to compare.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. MX, US, ES, BR.

city.description: City. If given, every persona is from this city.

market.description: Where the simulated people live and work.

roles.description: Who answers. Default: business_owner. The sample is split evenly across roles.

name.description: retail, restaurants, convenience_stores, services, construction, or any free-text industry.

weight.description: Share of the sample in percent; weights must add up to 100. Omit all weights for an even split.

model.description: fast: low cost (default). heavy: deeper answers, higher price. Both rank ideas the same way; heavy is more demanding with the idea, so its net movement comes out lower.

study_type.description: Defaults to the template’s study type.

language.description: Language of answers and report, e.g. es, es-MX, en, pt-BR. Default es. Use the language of the user.

tools.name: start_study
tools.description: Starts a market simulation study and returns a job_id. PAID per study; price = agents × rate (see estimate_study), minimum $0.10. Paid with x402 (USDC on Base): without a payment it returns the x402 payment requirements; an x402-capable client pays and retries automatically. Nothing is charged if the request is rejected. Takes 1 to 15 minutes depending on sample size; poll get_study.

idea.description: The product, idea or topic to study, in plain words. For a product include the price and how it works. Do not embellish it: agents react to exactly this text.

template.description: saas_validation: reaction to a product. route_comparison: choose between 2 or 3 routes (requires options). problem_discovery: what hurts in an industry, without showing a solution.

options.description: Only for route_comparison: the 2 or 3 routes to compare.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. MX, US, ES, BR.

city.description: City. If given, every persona is from this city.

market.description: Where the simulated people live and work.

roles.description: Who answers. Default: business_owner. The sample is split evenly across roles.

name.description: retail, restaurants, convenience_stores, services, construction, or any free-text industry.

weight.description: Share of the sample in percent; weights must add up to 100. Omit all weights for an even split.

model.description: fast: low cost (default). heavy: deeper answers, higher price. Both rank ideas the same way; heavy is more demanding with the idea, so its net movement comes out lower.

study_type.description: Defaults to the template’s study type.

language.description: Language of answers and report, e.g. es, es-MX, en, pt-BR. Default es. Use the language of the user.

tools.name: get_study
tools.description: Returns the status and progress of a study and, when it has finished, the report. Free. While status is queued or running, call again in 10 to 20 seconds. Use sections to fetch only part of a large report.

sections.description: Report blocks to return. Default: all of them.

tools.name: get_example_report
tools.description: Returns a complete example report from a real run (100 agents, Mexico, restaurants and convenience stores), to see the structure before paying for a study. Free.
